posts.text:
Load a routine and your agent performs it: sign, celebrate, dance. Add a beat while it plays and the stage follows.

A routine is a performance built from gestures on a timeline. Each row is one beat: drag to reorder, set how long it holds, and point any step at a different clip. Save it to an agent you own and it travels with that agent, so any embed can play it by name.

three.ws/choreograph

Five performances ship as starting points. A step names a slot rather than a file, so a routine shared with another agent still plays that agent's own take on each gesture. A routine holds up to 24 steps.
